name: cueston
description: Build, preview and publish in-app product tours, tooltips, banners, checklists, surveys and announcements on your SaaS app, and read their analytics (76 tools, OAuth).

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration) and choose read, write or publish access.

npm.description: Local stdio bridge. Run `npx cueston login` once, or set CUESTON_API_KEY.

examples.title: Onboarding tour
examples.description: Build a draft product tour on real pages
examples.prompt: Create a 4-step onboarding tour on our dashboard page and send me a preview link.

examples.title: Feature announcement
examples.prompt: Draft an announcement banner for our new reports feature, shown to admins only.

examples.title: Guide analytics
examples.prompt: Which of our tours have the lowest completion rate, and where do users drop off?
